headline: Fronts Shift as Border Battles Gather Pace
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the fighting has shifted rather than slackened. Nevish Line, once the foremost active front, has gone quiet in the last two hours, though it still records 12 events in six hours and 52 across the day; all eight bases are now Colonial-held, compared with one neutral position in the previous edition. Linn Mercy likewise has no fresh two-hour event but logged five in six hours and 39 in 24, retaining ten Colonial bases and one neutral. Callahans Passage remains a churned sector, with three events in six hours and 19 in the day, while its ten bases remain Warden-held. Weathered Expanse has seen two events in the latest two hours and 34 across the day, standing at six Warden bases and three neutral. Marban Hollow is the liveliest immediate watch: five events in two hours, 16 in 24, and a divided ledger of three Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral bases. Callums Cape has also stirred sharply, with three events in two hours, accelerating casualty and enlistment rates, and six Warden bases against one Colonial. Other fronts presently show little ownership movement.
